name: The Rothschild household at 2112 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_rothschild_mrs_m_m

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2112 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2112 Mrs. M. M. Rothschild & dr.; Jesse Rothschild.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2112, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The five live-in staff and two children it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. Left off: Jeannie Rothschild (the eldest daughter in 1900; which daughter is the 1904 "& dr." is not known, so the daughters are named in that line's note); Maurice Rothschild (a grown son (given name hard to read) the 1904 Blue Book does not list at the house). The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: Mrs. M. M. Rothschild
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Rose Rothschild here as head, born April 1860, in Illinois, widowed (ED 40, sheet 15A, line 26, leaf n822).

persons.name: Miss Rothschild
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& dr.' after the household's name: an unmarried daughter at home, not named. 'Miss Rothschild' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name. The 1900 census lists the unmarried daughter at home as Jeannie Rothschild (born November 1878 (the figures are hard to read), in Illinois, single; ED 40, sheet 15A, line 27, leaf n822). She is very likely the one the book means, but the book does not say.

persons.name: Jesse Rothschild
persons.note: A son is read from the shared surname under the head's listing; the Blue Book does not state the relationship. The 1900 census lists Jesse Rothschild here as son, born February 1886 (the figures are hard to read), in Illinois, at school (ED 40, sheet 15A, line 29, leaf n822).

persons.name: Emma Rothschild

born.note: The census gives December 1887, age 12 on 1 June 1900.

occupation.note: Written as "At school" in the occupation column on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a daughter of the head (at school); born December 1887, in Illinois. The 1904 Blue Book names no children, so a child at home in 1900 is placed here in 1904 by inference. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
